title: Escalating API outages to on-call engineering
body: When a customer reports 5xx errors from the API, set the ticket to urgent, add the escalated tag and leave an internal note with the incident number before paging on-call.

title: Understanding 502 Bad Gateway responses
body: A 502 means a proxy between the client and our API could not get a valid response. Check whether the error comes from our edge or from the customer's own proxy.
